data.name: Mubayyan
data.gender_notes: Mubayyan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who makes things clear or evident. The name Mubayyan carries the meaning “Explanatory, Clear, Evident” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mubayyan usually hope their child will grow to embody explanatory, clear, evident and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies guidance and clarity, helping the bearer navigate through life's complexities.
data.etymology: Mubayyan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Explanatory, Clear, Evident.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubayyan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُبَيَّن
in_arabic.meaning: اسم الله الحسنى، واضح وظاهر، بين البين، ظاهر
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُبَيَّن هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الواضح الظاهر الذي لا خفاء عليه شيء، وهو الذي بينه وبين خلقه الحجج والبراهين، ومنه قوله: وَهُوَ مُبَيِّنٌ كَفيلٌ مُطَبِّنٌ

in_urdu.name: مُبَیَّن
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کا نام، واضح، ظاہر، بین البین
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُبَیَّن اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واضح اور ظاہر۔ یہ نام ان صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے لے واسط ہیں، جیسے کہ واضح ہونا، ظاہر ہونا، اور مخلوق کے لئے قابل فہم ہونا۔

in_hindi.name: मुबय्यन
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का नाम, स्पष्ट, प्रकट, जाहिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबय्यन अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट और प्रकट। यह नाम उन विशेषताओं को प्रकट करता है जो अल्लाह के लिए हैं, जैसे कि स्पष्ट होना, प्रकट होना और सृष्टि के लिए समझने योग्य होना।

in_pashto.name: مُبَيَّن
in_pashto.meaning: د الله نوم، روښان، ښکاره، پيدا
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُبَيَّن د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، چې معنی يې ده روښان او ښکاره. دا نوم هغه صفات ښکاره کوي کومې چې د الله تعالی لپاره دي، لکه څنګه چې روښان وي، ښکاره وي او د خلکو لپاره پيدا وي.

in_english.name: Mubayyan
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's names, clear, evident, manifest
in_english.long_meaning: Mubayyan is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning clear, evident, or manifest. This name reflects the attributes that are inherent to Allah, such as being clear, evident, and understandable to His creation. It is derived from the Arabic root 'B-Y-N', which conveys the sense of clarity and distinction. In Islamic tradition, Mubayyan signifies Allah's quality of being distinctly clear and manifest in His signs, revelations, and guidance to humanity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mubayyan holds great significance in Islamic culture as it evokes a sense of clarity, guidance, and wisdom. Mubayyan can be seen as a manifestation of an individual's commitment to seeking truth and understanding, which is a core tenant of Islamic belief. The name may also be associated with leadership, as a Mubayyan is someone who can make complex situations clear and provide direction.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mubayyan carries profound meaning. It represents a deep connection to knowledge and wisdom, encouraging individuals to seek understanding and clarity in their faith and lives. The name can serve as a reminder of the importance of spiritual enlightenment and personal growth, which is a lifelong journey in Islamic teachings. The spiritual significance of the name also highlights the importance of personal introspection and reflection, as gaining clarity and understanding often comes from within. By embracing the name Mubayyan, individuals are encouraged to live a life of intellectual curiosity, compassion, and understanding.
